sn12.54:1.2: Seyyathāpi bhikkhave telaṃ ca paṭicca vaṭṭiṃ ca paṭicca telappadīpo jhāyeyya ||
sn12.54:1.3: tatra puriso kālena kālam telam āsiñceyya vaṭṭiṃ upasaṃhareyya ||
sn12.54:1.4: evam hi so bhikkhave telappadīpo tadāhāro tadupādāno ciraṃ dīgham addhānaṃ jāleyya ||
sn12.54:1.5: Evam eva kho bhikkhave saññojaniyesu dhammesu assādānupassino viharato taṇhā pavaḍḍhati ||
sn12.54:1.7: Evam etassa kevalassa dukkhakkhandhassa samudayo hoti || || 3
sn12.54:2.1: Seyyathāpi bhikkhave telaṃ ca paṭicca vaṭṭiṃ ca paṭicca telappadīpo jhāyeyya ||
sn12.54:2.2: tatra na kālena kālam telam āsiñceyya na vaṭṭiṃ ca upasaṃhareyya ||
sn12.54:2.3: Evañ hi so bhikkhave telappadīpo purimassa ca upādānassa pariyādānā aññassa ca anupāhārā anāhāro nibbāyeyya || ||
sn12.54:2.4: Evam eva kho bhikkhave saññojaniyesu dhammesu ādīnavānupassino viharato taṇhā nirujjhati ||
sn12.54:2.6: Evam etassa kevalassa dukkhakkhandhassa nirodho hotīti || ||
